source: Six alternating T-3050d per-call capture blocks (m0a, m1a, m0b, m1b, m0c, m1c) on the A-EX artifact at cap 4096, FinishParallelTasks 4, Zen 2 dev box; 1,524 timed calls per block.
rule: Per mode and arm/depth: the median of the calls in each block, then the median of the three block medians. LayerCostMs/LayerCostPerPositionMs and PromptTokenCostMs/PromptTokenCostPerPositionMs: the chunk-1 upper envelope over depths 1, 1024, 2048, 3072, 4095 (slope = (last - first) / span floored at 0; intercept from the depth-1 median, raised by the largest residual). Batched pair: per-token medians (call / 8) at positions depth + 3.5 over depths 1, 1024, 2048, 3072, 4088, the chord extended to position 0 and raised by the largest residual. Every value rounded upward by ceil(x * 10^d - 1e-9) / 10^d, d = 3 for millisecond fields and 6 for per-position fields (D-SLM8113). Mode-0 BatchedPromptTokenCostMs is 15.022198 exact, so 15.023 (D-SLM8108).
status: Reasonable measured starting defaults, not certified costs or accuracy bounds.
